g.text: Chosen: palette 'river', type pairing 'civic'. Ratios are WCAG 2.x contrast. Kit minimum shown in brackets.
Calm, civic, outdoorsy. Reads as competent and local. Not associated with either major US party.
Rooted, steady, neighborly. Good for parks, schools, land use and rural races.
Warm and distinctive. Stands out in a crowded field of red, white and blue signs.
Type pairings (all SIL Open Font License, free from Google Fonts)
Civic — Public Sans + Source Serif 4 ← chosen
Fix the flooding. Finally. Public Sans was designed for government websites: plain, trustworthy, very
legible. Source Serif adds warmth for longer reading on mailers and the website.
Fix the flooding. Finally. Designed by the Braille Institute for readers with low vision. The most accessible choice; a
good default if your district skews older.
Fix the flooding. Finally. A condensed headline face fits long names on a yard sign at a bigger size. Public
